items.title: Motorola Solutions (MSI) Stock Looks Overvalued Even After Strong Cash Flow Growth
items.summary: Motorola Solutions has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, and the market is now reacting to fresh news on profit, acquisitions and capital returns. With the stock around US$530.40, the key question is whether that price still lines up with the cash flows the business can generate over time. items.title: Axon vs. Motorola: Which Public Safety Stock Has More Upside After Q3 Earnings?
items.summary: Axon shares fell about 28% after an EPS miss and cautious guidance, while Motorola Solutions rose roughly 7% on an earnings beat, raised guidance, and record backlog in their Q3 2026 reports.

items.title: Motorola Solutions’s Q3 2026 earnings call: our top 5 analyst questions
items.summary: Motorola Solutions delivered double-digit revenue growth in the latest quarter, driven by continued strength across both public safety and enterprise segments. Management pointed to robust demand for its Silvus tactical communications platform and a series of large contract wins in land mobile radio (LMR) and video solutions as key contributors.
